name: record_deduplicator
description: Record deduplicator identifying duplicate entities by primary key or fuzzy matching fields.

requirements.description: Deduplicate records with matching key fields.
Merge record attributes deterministically when deduplicating.
examples: r1={id:1, val:None}, r2={id:1, val:'a'} -> merged={id:1, val:'a'}
edge_cases: conflicting non-null values favor earlier record
